concurrency.description: Max concurrent queries. Omit to use server default.

sleep.description: Seconds to sleep between query status checks. Omit to use default of 3 seconds.

dashboardIds.description: Comma-separated dashboard IDs to run. Omit to run all dashboards.

chartIds.description: Comma-separated chart IDs to run. Omit to run all charts.

reportIds.description: Comma-separated report IDs to run. Omit to run all reports.

isFetch.description: Fetch latest data from the database

getRepoNodes.description: Include repo file nodes in output

chartId.description: Chart ID to get query info for. Omit if querying a dashboard or report.

dashboardId.description: Dashboard ID to get query info for. Omit if querying a chart or report.

tileIndex.description: Dashboard tile index. Omit to get all tiles.

reportId.description: Report ID to get query info for. Omit if querying a chart or dashboard.

rowId.description: Report row ID. Omit to get all rows.

timeSpec.description: Time specification for the query. Omit to use default time range.

timeRangeFractionBrick.description: Time range fraction brick. Omit to use default.

isFetch.description: Fetch latest data from the database

columnName.description: Column name to sample. Omit to get all columns from the table.

offset.description: Row offset for pagination. Omit to start from the first row.

isRefreshExistingCache.description: Refresh cached schemas from the database

pageIds.description: One or more documentation page ids. Use list-docs to see available ids.

query.description: Search query. Whitespace-separated terms are AND-matched (case-insensitive) against documentation file contents.
